terms.proofCondition: $3,000 of settled cash collected by day 30

strategy.title: Sell the lien-sale compliance workbook to self-storage operators by email
strategy.why: Every link is evidenced on the card: 18 paid invoices at $250 from 150 contacts (12% measured on this offer's own sales), 340 operators in the association directory who need monthly lien notices, Brain produces the spreadsheet itself at $4 direct cost, no capital tied up, and cash settles 4 days after sale. 12 deals reach $3,000; we plan 13 from about 150 contacts (expected 18), well inside the 340 available.

alternatives.why: Not evidenced; the $250 price is the one buyers actually paid, so it is kept.

facts.value: 340 self-storage operators are listed in the state self-storage association member directory; each must send statutory lien-sale notices for delinquent units every month.
Sell A workbook that schedules statutory lien-sale notices and documents each auction step to each buyer.
Self-storage operators paid $250 per lien-compliance workbook in this offer's first outreach (18 paid invoices, 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-20).

reviews.reasons: Single opening with every chain link evidenced on this offer's own record: price $250 is what these buyers actually paid (18 paid invoices 2026-11-02..11-20), conversion 18/150 = 12% measured on this offer's own sales, delivery is a spreadsheet Brain produces (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET proved), direct cost $4, exposure $0, cash in 4 days. Arithmetic recomputed: 12 deals reach $3,000 (12 x $250); plan 13 x $250 = $3,250 gross, 13 x $4 = $52 cost, net $3,198. 13 deals from 150 contacts needs 8.7% against measured 12% (expected 18). Receipts day 4, settle day 8, proof day 14, inside 30 days. The $52 cost is spent day 8 after receipts settle, so no owner capital is fronted (ownerFunded 0, exposure 0) and the no-up-front-capital limit holds. Stance EXECUTABLE is right: nothing the plan relies on is an unknown; the contract has no owner-hours ceiling (card says 0.5 h).
findings: The first outreach already contacted 150 of the 340 directory operators and 18 bought a one-time workbook; the new outreach should go to the ~190 not yet contacted (excluding prior buyers). At 12% that is ~23 expected orders vs 13 needed, so volume still holds, but the MARKET_VOLUME basis 'each buying about every 30 days' overstates repeat demand for a one-off workbook.
Execution prerequisites: SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED; email sending and invoicing must be connected before day 1. This is setup, not an evidential unknown.
Brain's own summary lists the deliver step as PERSON, while the card and plan record delivery as a spreadsheet Brain produces; the plan's BRAIN performer matches the card's recorded fulfiller.
